title: Des Noyers 1659: Pierre Des Noyers to Ismaël Boulliau, note in cipher on Marie Mancini, [Danzig, December 1659] (BnF Fr. 13020 f. 297): contemporary decipherment transcribed, key rebuilt

plaintext.source: Contemporary interlinear decipherment (gloss) above each group, probably by Boulliau.

system.summary: Two-digit numerical nomenclator (00-99): letters and syllables; a mark above a group (ring, circumflex, cross, bar, accent) makes it a code word

prior_solution.where: Contemporary interlinear gloss on the manuscript; not printed in the 1859 edition of the letters (which prints the other passages of 1658-1659).

conditions.human_role: Brice Dudout chose the target from the catalogue and set the rules (frozen key before validation, held-out checks, prior-work search the day of publication); AI agents transcribed, solved, checked and wrote up. Doubtful signs were settled by targeted visual review where stated.
models: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic), agents run by Brice Dudout

solution.what: The 1656 sign key (f. 315) tested on the glossed passages: 0/41 agreements on groups 3-39 (controls mean 0.001); no sign of its alphabet.
Table rebuilt from cipher / gloss pairs of 12 passages: 88 groups, 88.8% consistency (code words 97.2%, controls <= 34%).
Leave-one-out check of f. 297 against the other 11 passages: 24 groups, 18 certain, 2 probable, 4 restored from the gloss only.

outcome.method_basis: Existing contemporary decipherment: interlinear gloss of the time, checked group by group against a table rebuilt from the other glossed passages of the same correspondence.
outcome.fraction_read_source: 12/12 words read in their sense; 6 certain, 2 probable, 4 restored, 0 unresolved.

credits.note: the interlinear gloss of the time on f. 297 (probably by Boulliau) gives the clear text; the eleven other glossed passages of Fr. 13020 (1658-1659) give the key

cipher and gloss of f. 297 transcribed and checked group by group; the 00-99 nomenclator with marks rebuilt from the twelve glossed passages of Fr. 13020 (key.tsv, key recovered); the 1656 key of f. 315 ruled out; English translation. Content existing (contemporary gloss), not a solution

texts.label: Pierre Des Noyers to Ismaël Boulliau, note in cipher, [Dec 1659]
texts.summary: But for the Queen, no one would wait for the death of the Prince of Spain to break off the marriage; la Mancini must be very bold.
texts.note: Existing: the text is the contemporary interlinear gloss, checked against the rebuilt table; 12 words, 6 certain, 2 probable, 4 restored, 0 unresolved.

reading_review.by: AI language-model agent (Claude Opus 5.5, for Brice Dudout; a model reading, not a person)
reading_review.note: Read as sentences 4 Nov 2026: one complete French sentence of 1659 in the spelling of the time ('despagne', 'ardie' = hardie), coherent with its plain-text frame and with the news of the Spanish marriage and Marie Mancini in late 1659.
